verdict.rationale: Cognee's UI covers uploading data, exploring graphs, running searches and managing datasets. Its documented API covers most of that: remember for ingestion, recall for search, forget for dataset and item deletion, improve for enrichment, plus a Docker-served API on port 8000. However, no source states API/UI parity, graph exploration via the API is not evidenced, and probes for a published OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity statement, API-level graph exploration/visualization, published REST/OpenAPI reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
